pages.text: In this ritual an $(#ad03fc)Endermite$() is tricked into spawning. The stone and dirt represent the surroundings, then an egg is thrown to simulate the use of an ender pearl. When the mite spawns, the summoned $(#ad03fc)Foliot$() immediately possesses it, visits $(#ad03fc)The End$(), and $()
returns. The $(#ad03fc)Possessed Endermite$() will always drop at least one $(item)end stone$() when killed.$(br)
